title: How is Attila the Hun connected to Squidward?
description:
A Raphael fresco, the line of popes, two White House visits and a Hollywood ceremony connect Attila the Hun to Squidward, through his voice, Rodger Bumpass.

Attila → Pope Leo I → Pope Francis → Joe Biden → Mark Hamill → Rodger Bumpass → Squidward Tentacles

How they're connected (every photo is real and sourced):
1. Attila the Hun → Pope Leo I: Around 1514, Raphael painted Pope Leo I meeting Attila the Hun, who spared Rome in 452.
   Photo by Raphael, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Raphael_-_The_Meeting_of_Leo_the_Great_and_Attila.jpg
2. Pope Leo I → Pope Francis (9 portraits, every holder): From Leo, the 45th pope, the line runs unbroken to the 266th, Pope Francis.
   Photo, Public domain / CC0 / CC BY-SA 3.0 / GFDL 1.2 / unknown: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Herrera_mozo_San_Le%C3%B3n_magno_Lienzo._%C3%93valo._164_x_105_cm._Museo_del_Prado.png + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Exultet_Rolls_of_Southern_Italy,_detail_of_Pope_Gregory_VII.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Innocent_III_(Monastery_of_Subiaco).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pedro_Berruguete_-_Portrait_of_Pope_Sixtus_IV_della_Rovere_-_1916.815_-_Cleveland_Museum_of_ArtFXD.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pius_IX,_by_Adolphe_Braun,_1875.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pius_XII_with_tabard,_by_Michael_Pitcairn,_1951_(retouched).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:ADAMELLO_-_PAPA_-_Giovanni_Paolo_II_-_panoramio_(cropped).jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Benedykt_XVI_(2010-10-17)_2.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Francis_Korea_Haemi_Castle_19_(4x5_cropped).jpg
3. Pope Francis → Joe Biden: In 2015, Vice President Joe Biden greeted Pope Francis at the White House.
   Photo by David Lienemann, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Pope_Francis_and_Joe_Biden_at_the_White_House.jpg
4. Joe Biden → Mark Hamill: In 2024, President Biden welcomed Star Wars legend Mark Hamill to the Oval Office.
   Photo by The White House, Public domain: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:P20240503AS-0590_(53783780087).jpg
5. Mark Hamill → Rodger Bumpass: In 2025, Hamill, the Flying Dutchman in the new SpongeBob movie, posed with the cast, including Rodger Bumpass.
   Photo by Getty Images for Paramount Pictures, via Mulderville, Fair use (commentary): https://mulderville.net/en/events/2990/the-spongebob-movie-search-for-squarepants-hollywood-honors-spongebob-squarepants-with-a-hand-footprint-ceremony
6. Rodger Bumpass → Squidward: And Rodger Bumpass has been the voice of Squidward since 1999.
   Photo by Gage Skidmore, Nickelodeon (NickRewind), CC BY-SA 3.0 / CC BY 3.0: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Rodger_Bumpass_by_Gage_Skidmore.jpg + https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Squidward_Tentacles_character.png

Give me two names in the comments and I'll find the photos that connect them.

#attila #squidwardtentacles #sixdegrees #history #didyouknow #shorts
